en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I need to meet up with Tsumugi!
I should head over.
<CLT=cltMIND>I still have some time before it's nighttime...

<CLT=cltMIND>What should I do? I don't want to
just sit around and do nothing.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us...
But there's nothing displayed right now.
<CLT=cltMIND>I guess I'll check up on everyone until then.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to rest in bed?
Free Time will end if you do.

<CLT=cltMIND>That's a pretty large lamp...
It makes the room nice and bright.

<CLT=cltMIND>Lost of uniforms identical to my own
line the inside of the closet.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder who prepared all this, and
how they did it...
